events.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a personal-conduct controversy; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, stock down ~35% from its October peak (worst since June 2025), at least 10 analysts cut to Hold citing no clear successor; Q3 FY2027 earnings due after close today

CBS News: Iranian claims of tankers striking mines near Strait of Hormuz are largely unverified/disputed (CENTCOM called one claim 'FALSE', Trump accuses Iran of fabricating to raise oil prices); UKMTO independently confirms separate projectile strikes on tankers continue, and the US naval blockade on Iranian oil ports remains in place

China's rare-earth export-control pause (covering holmium, erbium, thulium, europium, ytterbium and related processing tech) was set to expire Nov 10; as of early Nov it had not yet been formally re-extended, leaving legal status of the suspension uncertain even as other reporting claims a Jan 10, 2027 extension was announced

CNBC: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says the Fed may need up to four more rate hikes; Chicago Fed's Goolsbee called October's hotter-than-expected CPI 'borderline disturbing'; CME FedWatch shows fed funds futures unanimously pricing a December hike after October's hold (two governors dissented in favor of hiking then)
